title: What has moved since the last update
intro: watch answers a different question from doctor: not what is wrong, but what has changed. It exits 11 for drift and never 10, so no hook blocks on it.

scenarios.title: Nothing has drifted
scenarios.explain: Exit 0. The policy hash matches the one recorded at the last update and every projection matches its fingerprint.

scenarios.title: The policy was edited and not regenerated
scenarios.explain: Exit 11 is DRIFT, which is information rather than a verdict. The generated instruction files no longer follow from the policy they were generated from, and `majordomus update` is the fix.
